query: We run GitLab CI/CD with merge trains on a Premium plan and a self-hosted Hive at https://hive.internal.example.com/graphql. Set up schema checks on merge requests and publishing on merge to the default branch for our single-schema project (schema.graphql at the repo root). Hive project: acme/api, target: staging.
expected_behavior: Recommends flow A or C and explains that flow B is not available on GitLab because merge train pipelines do not expose the commit an entry is built on, and asks the user to choose before writing .gitlab-ci.yml
Sets HIVE_REGISTRY to the self-hosted registry endpoint for the CLI, and never uses HIVE_ENDPOINT or --registry
Runs the jobs in the pinned CLI image with entrypoint: [''] and excludes merge train pipelines from the check job with a merge_train rule
Leaves out --service and --url because the project is a single schema
Keeps the check token unprotected and the publish token protected, both as masked CI/CD variables
